title: Software that manages and extends the physical system
body: The hardware decides whether a door opens. Veranda's software decides who, when, and why, then keeps a record of everything that happened.

showcase.title: One window into the Veranda platform
showcase.body: The Dashboard app is one interface into Veranda's software. Check the status of deliveries, open or lock a device, set access schedules, or grant access to authorized people remotely. The same platform also serves operators managing many devices and the partner systems that feed it.

image.alt: Veranda Dashboard app on a phone

responsibilities.title: Access & permissions
responsibilities.body: Decide who can open which access point, and change or revoke those rights at any time.

responsibilities.title: Scheduled access
responsibilities.body: Set recurring windows for planned deliveries, service visits, and pickups.

responsibilities.title: Device & sensor monitoring
responsibilities.body: Follow lock state, battery, connectivity, and sensor readings across every device.

responsibilities.title: Activity & events
responsibilities.body: Review a complete history of opens, closes, and changes in condition.

responsibilities.title: Status updates & alerts
responsibilities.body: Let the right people know when a delivery arrives or something looks out of the ordinary.

responsibilities.title: Users, operators & partners
responsibilities.body: Support everyday users, the teams running fleets of devices, and partner workflows.
